title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: Data Literacy and Periodic Retesting
prompt: In many universities, students are tested on their understanding of data and statistics only once, at the end of a course, and are not retested later. Some educators argue that periodic retesting is essential because data literacy fades quickly and decisions based on outdated knowledge can be harmful. What problems can arise when data understanding is assessed only once, and what solutions would you recommend to ensure that students retain and apply data skills over time? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为学术类 Task 2 模拟练习题。所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请针对“一次性数据理解评估”带来的问题提出至少两个具体问题，并给出相应的解决方案；需明确表达立场并提供理由与例子。建议先列出问题—解决方案对应关系，再展开论证。字数不少于 250 词。
